parole.significato: A member of an indigenous North American people of Algonquian stock.
parole.testo: From Miami Myaamia, the endonym for the tribe in Miami-Illinois, an Algonquian language.

parole.significato: A member of a Native American tribe, historically part of the Illinois Confederation.
parole.testo: From Miami peewaareewa (“comes carrying a pack on his back”).

parole.testo: From Miami Pinkwaawilenionki (“place of the ash men”).

parole.significato: An indigenous people of western Indiana, USA and surrounding regions .
parole.testo: Clipping of Waiatanwa and other forms, derived from Miami waayaahtanwa, from waayaahtanonki (“place of the whirpool”).
